title: SG-1.4.1 · Create the HeaderOverlay component wired to the UI store
summary: HeaderOverlay component in game/frontend/src/components with worldTitle, round, loading and error props
description: Context: game/frontend has no HeaderOverlay yet. App.tsx renders RoundBadge (which shows a bare 'Round unavailable' on failure) and Countdown directly. Desired behavior: a HeaderOverlay component takes props worldTitle, round, loading and error and shows the logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings button, wired to useUiStore, with loading, empty and error states that explain a round API failure. Expected result: a tested, standalone component. Why: the compact header and honest round-failure messaging are required by the StoryForge redesign.
acceptance_criteria: Given a round, When HeaderOverlay renders, Then logo, world title, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings button are visible
Given the sound toggle and settings button are clicked, When the store is read, Then soundEnabled and settingsOpen have flipped
Given loading, no round, or an error, When HeaderOverlay renders, Then a loading, empty or error message is shown, and the error message explains the failure

in_scope: Use of existing useUiStore, Countdown and lucide-react icons
out_of_scope: Composing HeaderOverlay into App or GameLayout
preserve: Existing Countdown and RoundBadge behavior and tests

technical_constraints: React + TypeScript + Tailwind classes; lucide-react icons; Button from components/ui/button
State read via useUiStore selectors from src/store/uiStore.ts
